1) The majority of nurses in the UK do not have a degree and are not in a position to benefit from the opportunities that higher education can offer.
the role of highereducation for nurses in the UK is to prepare them for the future, not the past.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to nurse education, one that is based on the development of capability in the student nurse, rather than the acquisition of knowledge and skills.
the role of higher educational institutions in the development of nurses and the development of the profession.
how the development of capability in nursing students is influenced by their learning environment and the role of higher educational institutions in this development.

higher education is essential to the development of the profession and to the preparation of nurses for the future.
higher education is not essential for nurses to practice but it is essential if they are to be capable.
higher education has a place in nursing education and that the place is in the development of capability.

higher education should prepare nurses for the future.
higher education should be a part of nursing education.

the current state of the art in higher education for nurses is not sufficient to develop capability in all of the nurses who enter the profession.
